biotools.summary: scATAnno is a Python package that automatically annotates single-cell ATAC-seq data using reference atlases, integrating query data without relying on scRNA-seq data. It generates reference atlases from publicly available datasets and incorporates uncertainty scores to improve annotation accuracy.
